//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the DETAIL PANEL content shell — `.pa-detail-panel__content` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.DetailPanel.detail_panel/1`, svelte `display/DetailPanel.svelte`). SCOPE = the CONTENT SHELL ONLY (the inner tree shared by all three display modes: __header [__title + optional __actions + __close] → optional __tabs → __body → optional __footer, with an optional .pa-detail-panel-resize handle). The three OUTER mode wrappers — inline/card-overlay `.pa-detail-view` (svelte `DetailView`, keen `detail_view/1`) and the fixed `.pa-detail-panel--overlay` (keen `detail_panel_overlay/1`, svelte `SlidePanel`) — are OUT OF SCOPE here (their classes are listed under `deferred`); add `detail-view` as its own fixture key later if desired. The shells reconcile into real goldens: both wrappers emit `h4.pa-detail-panel__title` (NOT h3), a `.pa-detail-panel__close` whose only child is the masked `<span class="pa-icon pa-icon--x">` affordance (aria-label "Close" in both — svelte via pureAdmin.buttons.close, keen via pureAdmin.a11y.close), and the optional __actions/__tabs/__footer are `:if`-gated on their slot in both. The resize handle renders as a bare `<div class="pa-detail-panel-resize">` in both (svelte's drag event handlers + bind:this are not serialized in SSR; keen renders it inert — the PureAdminDetailPanel hook lives on the outer `.pa-detail-view__panel`, out of scope). Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/detail-panel.html + _detail-panel.scss.

propsVocabulary.title: Panel title → the canonical `<h4 class="pa-detail-panel__title">` (svelte `titleText`, keen `title_text`). h4, not h3 — detail-panel titles are smaller than card/modal.
propsVocabulary.bordered: Top + bottom borders on the content wrapper → `pa-detail-panel__content--bordered` (svelte `isBordered`, keen `is_bordered`).
propsVocabulary.resizable: Render the drag-resize handle `.pa-detail-panel-resize` inside the content (svelte `isResizable`, keen `is_resizable`; default TRUE). The handle is inert markup here — the drag behaviour (PureAdminDetailPanel hook) binds on the outer `.pa-detail-view__panel`, which is out of this fixture's scope.
propsVocabulary.actions: Header action buttons → `.pa-detail-panel__actions`, between the title and the close button (mirrors `.pa-card__actions`). `:if`-gated on the slot.
propsVocabulary.tabs: Tabs region between header and body → `.pa-detail-panel__tabs` (hosts `.pa-tabs`). `:if`-gated on the slot.
propsVocabulary.footer: Footer actions → `.pa-detail-panel__footer` (primary confirm/cancel). `:if`-gated on the slot.

goldenConventions: Full-tree goldens — the content shell reconciles between the wrappers (verified by dumping both). The close-button aria-label is "Close" in both (different i18n keys, identical text — the modal-close convention). svelte's legacy `header` slot override (raw replacement of the h4) is out of the fixture's scope: scenarios always drive the blessed `titleText` → `h4.pa-detail-panel__title` path. Framework event wiring (svelte resize-handle handlers, keen phx-click on the close) is not part of the contract (SSR-omitted / phx-* stripped by the normalizer).

cssStateClasses.pa-detail-panel--open: JS/state toggle that slides the fixed-overlay panel in (mode wrapper, out of scope).
cssStateClasses.pa-detail-panel-resize--active: Added to the handle while a drag is in progress (runtime, by the PureAdminDetailPanel hook).
cssStateClasses.pa-detail-view__overlay--visible: Fades in the card-overlay backdrop while the panel is open (mode wrapper, out of scope).
cssStateClasses.pa-detail-view__panel--open: Expands the inline/card panel to its width while open (mode wrapper, out of scope).

deferred.//: Classes belonging to the OUTER mode wrappers (detail-view + fixed overlay), not this content-shell fixture. Each exists in _detail-panel.scss; a future `detail-view` fixture key can guard them.
deferred.pa-detail-view--overlay: Card-overlay mode on the layout root.
deferred.pa-detail-view__panel: Sliding detail panel column (carries the resize hook).
deferred.pa-detail-panel--mobile-overlay: Mobile variant of the fixed overlay.
